candidates.name: Fayetteville Lateral
candidates.sponsor: Texas Gas Transmission, LLC (Boardwalk Pipeline Partners)
candidates.to: interconnect with Texas Gas mainline near Mississippi line

evidence.note: Federal Register notice of FERC environmental review, docket CP07-417: about 262.6 miles of 36-inch pipe in two laterals, one primarily in Arkansas (Fayetteville Lateral) and one in Mississippi (Greenville Lateral). Per-lateral figures from search summaries (not yet read in a verified page): Fayetteville 166.2 mi, 157.2 mi in Arkansas, certificated; capacity 841,000 MMBtu/d.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for this lateral. Texas Gas P0263 is the main line only; P0145 Access South ends at Kosciusko but is a different system. Operating since 2009 (build year not verified in a loaded page). Length roughly 267 km.

candidates.name: Greenville Lateral
candidates.sponsor: Texas Gas Transmission, LLC (Boardwalk Pipeline Partners)

evidence.note: Same FERC docket CP07-417 notice; Greenville Lateral in Mississippi, about 96.4 miles of 36-inch per search summary.

candidates.why_maybe_new: out_of_slice: true (entirely in Mississippi). Could match P0145 Access South (Uniontown->Kosciusko) in part; consolidator should check.

candidates.name: Northern Border Chicago Project
candidates.to: Manhattan, Illinois, with extension toward Griffith, Indiana (Crossroads interconnect)

evidence.note: Federal Register notice of FERC final EIS for Northern Border proposals between Harper, Iowa and Chicago, Illinois (docket CP96-027).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Possible match to P2099 Northern Border Gas Pipeline (Port of Morgan->Fort Hayden, 1412 km), which may or may not include the Chicago extension. Search summary: about 218 mi of 30-inch Harper to Manhattan plus 45 mi of 24-inch toward Griffith, about 420 km; not verified in a loaded page. Consolidator to decide whether it is a separate row.
